title: Publish the html tier's registered intrinsic-element vocabulary in `sdui.manifest.json` (objectstack#20112 ruling A) — `div` stays deprecated
body:
Filed by the director seat from the maintainer's ruling on objectstack#20112 (batch #225 item 1, letter A, 「其他同意」). Reader who acts: the `domain:ui` execution seat. `area:*` is left for the objectui triage seat to stamp. Related: objectstack#19922 (`pm:blocked` behind objectstack#20112, which is now blocked on this card). Dedupe: semantic search in this repository for 「html tier intrinsic tags declared in sdui.manifest.json html-elements getPublicConfigs manifest vocabulary」 → 2 hits (objectui#7235, objectui#5461), neither this work.

## What the ruling settles

A `kind:'html'` page may author intrinsic HTML tags, and the producer already implements and declares them: `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/html-elements.tsx` registers the sanitised flow/inline set (h1–h6, p, a, blockquote, pre, strong/em/b/i/u/small/mark/sub/sup/del/ins/abbr, ul/ol/li/dl/dt/dd, figure/figcaption/img/hr/br/time/address/cite/q) with per-tag `inputs` and the `children` slot (objectui#9910); `span`, table, code, label and the sectioning tags are registered elsewhere. The console's html-tier compile (`packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx`) whitelists `ComponentRegistry.getKnownTypes()`, so those pages render today. The published `sdui.manifest.json` is built from `getPublicConfigs()` over `PUBLIC_BLOCKS` (`packages/core/src/registry/public-blocks.ts`: 59 curated blocks plus the `html` escape hatch), so the same tags are absent from the manifest the objectstack CLI gate reads, and objectstack's ledger `packages/lint/src/sdui-jsx-baseline.json` carries 200 rows of `jsx-forbidden-tag` / `jsx-unknown-component` over the three shipped html pages.

## Work

1. The published manifest (and the generated `sdui-intrinsics.d.ts`) declares the html tier's registered intrinsic set exactly as the registry declares it: every tag in `html-elements.tsx`'s `TAGS`, plus `span` and the table / code / label / sectioning tags registered elsewhere, each with its registered `inputs` and child slot. ⛔ `div` is not declared: the 2026-08-29 ruling (objectui#3965, PR objectui#6878) deprecated it in favour of `box`, and the gate must keep refusing it with `box` named as the replacement.
2. Premise to measure first: `getPublicConfigs()` / `PUBLIC_BLOCKS` is the sole source of `sdui.manifest.json` (`packages/sdui-parser/scripts/gen-manifest.ts`). If declaring these tags there would also make them part of the curated JSON-surface vocabulary (the manifest carries no tier marker), stop and report the fork in the report with a proposed marker or second list: ⛔ do not widen the JSON authoring surface silently.
3. Pins: the manifest carries each declared tag with its inputs; `div` absent; the registration-uniqueness test unchanged.
4. Changeset `minor` (the published manifest's declared accept set grows). `Clause-②: yes` — a contract review before enqueue.

## After it lands

objectstack consumes objectui through `.objectui-sha`; objectstack#20112 unlocks when the pin carries this change. The `domain:cli` lane then regenerates `sdui.manifest.json`, rewrites the showcase's `div` sites to `box`, ratchets the ledger to zero and lands objectstack#19922 unchanged.

Governing text: ADR-0080 Decision §3 「The registry is the contract — the spec owns only the envelope」; ADR-0081 §1 (`kind:'html'` is author-written HTML expressed as constrained JSX); the `html-elements.tsx` header (「For that tier to live up to its name, the everyday HTML tags an author reaches for … must each resolve to a renderer」); `public-blocks.ts` (`box` replaces the deprecated `div`).

Dedupe words: `html tier intrinsic tags manifest publish` · `sdui.manifest.json html-elements TAGS` · `getPublicConfigs intrinsic vocabulary`
